articles.title: A New Era for Gaming, ETHRWorld
articles.description: Microsoft has appointed Asha Sharma as the new CEO of Microsoft Gaming, succeeding Phil Spencer. With a background at Instacart and Meta, Sharma aims to lead Xbox into a transformative phase, focusing on innovation and artistic game development.
